ground.purpose: Page ground in light and the column fill. Also the text on the pager line.

ink.purpose: Body text in light. The pager line background, search matches and the call in flight.

bold.purpose: Groff bold, headings, code, table heads in light.

dim.purpose: Running head and foot, captions, copy button, calls still to come.

rule.purpose: Hairlines, the still frame, scrollbar track and the unfocused column's ring in light.

accent.purpose: Links, focus ring, the focused column's 4px ring, caret and accent-color in light.

select.purpose: Text selection and Starlight accent-low in light.

plate.purpose: Code plate, copy button, the still background and the wide-screen workspace backdrop in light.

stop.purpose: The one red, for stopped answers and danger asides in light.

dim-dark.purpose: Running head and foot in dark.

accent-dark.purpose: Links and focus ring in dark.

body.purpose: Home page, 404 and help dialog text, 16px / 1.55 (14px under 40rem), ligatures off.

running.purpose: Running head and foot lines in dim ink.

section.purpose: Capital section names in bold, same size as body.

code.purpose: Pre and inline code inherit the page font; docs code is 0.9375rem.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system has no shadows. Depth is the plate, the rule and reverse video.

motion.name: ncu-spring
motion.purpose: Niri's default spring (damping ratio 1, stiffness 800) over 0.4s. All motion uses it or is off.

motion.name: page-crossfade
motion.purpose: Pages crossfade while the docs header holds still. Only when prefers-reduced-motion is no-preference.

motion.name: page-slide
motion.value: 0.4s var(--ncu-spring), view transition types left and right
motion.purpose: Between the home page and the docs the page slides left going in and right coming back. Slide.astro adds the type on pagereveal.

motion.name: strip-slide
motion.purpose: On a wide screen the column strip slides to keep the focused column in view; the ring colour changes over 0.2s. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: replay-rows
motion.purpose: Call rows are next (dim), now (reverse video) or done (bold) as the clip plays.

motion.name: scroll-percentage
motion.value: animation-timeline: scroll(root) on a registered integer
motion.purpose: The pager line counts 0 to 100 as the page scrolls, and shows (END) at the bottom. Where unsupported, the percentage is absent.

components.name: Running Head
components.description: Name and section on both sides, the manual title between.

narrative.northStar: The Manual Page in a Terminal
narrative.overview:
The home page is the manual page niri-computer-use(1) as man shows it in a terminal: a running head and foot, capital section names, bold for what you type, underline for paths, and less's reverse-video status line pinned to the bottom. On a screen at least 75rem wide the page is a niri workspace: the man page is the focused column in a 4px amber ring, and EXAMPLE is the next column peeking in, 16px away on the plate backdrop. The 404 answers a missing page as man does, with "No manual entry for" the path and every page listed as man -k lists them. The docs wear the same colours and type through Starlight, with a running head over each page title and a running foot at the end.

Everything is set in JetBrains Mono Variable. Dark is a warm black with parchment ink, light is paper with brown-black ink, and one amber marks links and focus. The home page follows the system colour scheme; the docs follow Starlight's theme switch. One script (2.3 KB gzipped, plus Starlight's 1.1 KB prefetch) adds less's keys, search, copy buttons, column focus and the example's replay. Every page works without it.
keyCharacteristics: One face, JetBrains Mono Variable 400 and 700, ligatures off on the home page.
A warm dark and a paper light from one light-dark() palette; amber is the only accent.
Text indented 7ch under capital section names, in an 80ch measure.
Running head and foot on the home page and on every docs page.
The pager line: reverse video, sticky, scroll-driven percentage, (END), messages and search in the same line.
Wide screens: columns 16px apart on the plate, the focused one in a 4px amber ring, sliding on niri's spring.
Less's keys and help dialog, which the visitor can turn off (WCAG 2.1.4).
Print is black on white with each outside link's address after it.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono Variable is the only face, for text and code, on the home page and the docs.

rules.name: The Bold Rule
rules.body: Bold is the strongest ink, as groff bold in a terminal: bold weight and the bold colour together. Underline is for paths.

rules.name: The Reverse Video Rule
rules.body: The current place is shown in reverse video: ground on ink. The pager line, search matches, the call in flight and the docs sidebar's current page use it.

rules.name: The One Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is links, the focus ring, the focused column's ring, the caret and accent-color. It is not used as a fill, except the pale select tint for selection.

rules.name: The Flat Rule
rules.body: No shadows, gradients or blur. Separation is the plate, a one-pixel rule or reverse video.

dos: Do take colours from tokens.css; the home page and docs share it.
Do keep the running head and foot, and keep the foot's version and date from the build.
Do name sections in capitals and indent their text by 7ch (3ch under 40rem).
Do keep the focus ring amber, 2px, offset 2px; on the less line it is the ground colour.
Do keep every page readable and usable without JavaScript, and printable. The script only adds.
Do put motion on --ncu-spring and turn it off under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do ignore keys in fields and with modifiers, and keep the option to turn them off.
Do check colour pairs for contrast: the lowest is amber text on the select tint, 4.67 in light.
donts: Don't add a second typeface or a display face.
Don't add cards, shadows, gradients, glow or hero blocks.
Don't let the script own content or navigation; a link or a section must work without it.
Don't put amber on any fill other than the select tint.
Don't put uppercase labels, kickers or eyebrows above headings; capital section names are the heading itself.
Don't add decoration that is not part of a man page in a terminal.
